rungs.title: Worst case
rungs.what: UR-style joints (harmonic-drive rotor inertia), heavy links, fast approach, stiff position control. Stiff = today's tuning: the UR5e board gains (wn and zeta at the pick pose); 0.2 m/s the whole descent; reflected mass = the sticking-contact mass at the touch pose, ((J_v M^-1 J_v^T)^-1)_zz, the mass the touch peak follows. Touch peak 178 N rigid / 84 N soft; the arm then keeps pressing 58 / 56 N on the belt through the hold. On the rigid object it bounces off and hits again at 127 N, 81 ms after touch.

rungs.title: Move slower
rungs.change: approach 0.2 -> 0.05 m/s over the last 30 mm
rungs.what: Slowing down cuts the touch peak (rigid 178 -> 39 N, soft 84 -> 17 N); it does not cut the press (rigid 58 -> 65 N, soft 56 -> 59 N).

rungs.title: Backdrivable motors
rungs.what: Every joint's rotor 1.83e-3 kg.m2 in the plant and the description; stiff gains re-derived on this build's inertia so each joint keeps the UR5e gains' wn and zeta at the pick pose (sim.tuning). Reflected mass 7.6 -> 5.3 kg; touch peak rigid 39 -> 32 N, soft 17 -> 14 N.

rungs.title: Lighter arm
rungs.what: The six links' mass and inertia x 0.3 in both models; stiff gains re-derived again to keep wn and zeta. Reflected mass 5.3 -> 1.8 kg; touch peak rigid 32 -> 18 N, soft 14 -> 10 N.

rungs.title: Spring on the end
rungs.change: passive level compensator 200 N/m, 4 N preload, 30 mm
rungs.what: The board gains unchanged; the 50 g tip slides on the spring (10 N.s/m damper) between flange and cup. A crumple zone: 50 g in front of the contact instead of 1.8 kg; touch peak rigid 18 -> 9.5 N, soft 10 -> 9.5 N; press rigid 15 -> 7.1 N, soft 15 -> 7.1 N. On the soft object R3 already sat at the contact's own damper jump, B v = 10 N, which no mass behind the contact removes.

rungs.title: Impedance controller
rungs.change: stiff position control -> host_spring, soft z
rungs.what: K = (3000, 3000, 500 N/m; 150 N.m/rad), zeta 1, inertia damping, host cap = the board-damped ceiling / 2; the compensator stays on (cumulative). Impedance can't remove the touch peak (rigid 9.5 -> 10 N, soft 9.5 -> 10 N; the soft z lets the arm arrive a little faster, 0.050 -> 0.054 m/s) but stops the arm pushing on: press rigid 7.1 -> 4.2 N, soft 7.1 -> 4.1 N. Without the spring the same switch leaves the touch peak (rigid 18 -> 19 N, soft 10 -> 11 N) and cuts the press rigid 15 -> 4.1 N, soft 15 -> 4.0 N.
